title: Phase 1: ScopeIdSyntax + ScopeMode / ResourceFileSchema (core/shared/viaductschema)
description:

- Kotlin object with validate(id: String): Result method
- Single regex constant ([a-z]+) per AP-4 single-point syntax enforcement
- Valid IDs: "public", "internal" → success
- Invalid IDs: "Public", "123", "", "a-b" → failure with actionable message

## Task 1.2 — ScopeMode sealed interface + ResourceFileSchema

- Jackson serialization with sorted keys (ORDER_MAP_ENTRIES_BY_KEYS), Jackson 2.17.3
- FULL schema ID with empty scope set present by default (R-23-001)
- version field present (R-23-002)
- Scope sets sorted alphabetically (R-23-004)
- Sealed interface must compile to JVM 11-compatible bytecode

title: Phase 2.4: AssembleCentralSchemaTask scope-aware build pipeline + resource file generation
description:
Task 2.4 from .alucify/implementation-plan.md (v2). Wires the build-time scope materialization, validation, and resource-file emission into the existing AssembleCentralSchemaTask. Depends on Tasks 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2 (all merged).

## Scope
- File: gradle-plugins/application/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/gradle/task/AssembleCentralSchemaTask.kt (MODIFY)
- File: gradle-plugins/application/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/gradle/ViaductApplicationPlugin.kt (MODIFY — wire extension to task)
- Possibly new sibling helper file(s) under gradle-plugins/application/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/gradle/task/ or .../scopes/
- File: gradle-plugins/application/build.gradle.kts (verify implementation deps for shared:graphql + shared:viaductschema; add if missing)

## Build pipeline (strict phase ordering per R-19-001/R-19-002)
Read getSchemaScopeInfo() from the extension.
- If NoScopesMode → existing behavior preserved exactly (no resource file, no scope materialization). Backward compat (R-20-001 — verified later in Task 4.1).
- If ScopedMode:
  Phase 1 (declarations): already validated at config time by Task 2.1
  Phase 2 (SDL @scope): invoke existing ScopedSchemaBuilder.applyScopes via ScopeDirectiveParser(validScopeNames = scopeUniverse) for every UNIQUE declared scope set. Surface SchemaScopeValidationError as GradleException.
  Phase 3 (materialize + validate each unique scope set):
    - Run graphql.GraphQL.newGraphQL(filtered).execute(IntrospectionQuery.INTROSPECTION_QUERY) and assert empty errors (R-22-003)
    - Run PostTransformDirectiveStructureValidation + PostTransformStructuralValidation (R-22-004..R-22-008)
    - Cache scope-set → materialized schema; aliases sharing a scope set reuse one materialization (R-22-002)
  Phase 4 (resource file): write META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json using ResourceFileSchema + objectMapper() (sorted keys, R-23-001..R-23-005)
- Phases run in strict order; failure short-circuits and reports only current-phase error (AP-5 fail-fast)

## Resource file output
- Path: <outputDirectory>/META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json
- Use ResourceFileSchema.create(declaredSchemaScopes, declaredScopedSchemas, version) — Phase 1 default-FULL injection (R-23-001) and sorted keys (R-23-004) already handled
- Serialize with ResourceFileSchema.objectMapper()
- Must be a Gradle @OutputFile or covered by existing @OutputDirectory for UP-TO-DATE
- Deterministic byte-identical output for identical inputs (TS-010)

## Tests (TDD — write FAILING tests FIRST)
gradle-plugins/application/src/test/kotlin/viaduct/gradle/task/... + functional tests
- TS-005 — IC-2 transformSchema invoked per scope set
- TS-006 — IC-2 applyScopes correctness on a fixture SDL
- TS-007 — idempotent transformation: same scope set called twice → same materialized schema (cache hit, R-22-002)
- TS-008 — empty scope set materializes the full schema (FULL semantics)
- TS-009 — IC-3 writeResourceFile produces well-formed JSON
- TS-010 — deterministic output: two invocations with same inputs → byte-identical JSON
- TS-011 — sorted keys in JSON (R-23-005)
- TS-012 — sorted scope sets in JSON (R-23-004)
- TS-049 — CH-3 pipeline orchestration: multi-phase happy path + phase-3 introspection failure short-circuits
- R-22-001 — every declared unique scope set produces a materialized schema
- R-22-002 — alias IDs (multiple IDs → same scope set) share single materialization (introspect call count == unique scope sets, not total IDs)
- R-22-003 — introspection runs against each materialized schema, no errors
- R-22-004..R-22-008 — each post-transform validation step produces a passing result on the canonical fixture

Coverage demand from operator (verbatim):
- R-23-001: FULL schema ID with empty scope set present by default — assert it explicitly, not via "no exception thrown"
- R-23-002: version field present and non-empty in serialized output
- R-23-004: scope sets sorted alphabetically — assert against a fixture with deliberately unsorted input

title: Tracking: BatchResolverIntegrationTest intermittent ReadTimeoutException flake in demoapps/starwars:test
description:
Intermittent flake observed in demoapps/starwars during Phase 2 trust-and-verify runs. Reproduces ~1-in-N times on full-suite invocations of `./gradlew -p demoapps/starwars test --rerun-tasks` from per-phase worktrees; isolated re-runs of just BatchResolverIntegrationTest pass every time. Failure mode: ReadTimeoutException from the embedded HTTP client.

## Observations
- Phase 0 baseline (initial single-run starwars:test): clean, 0 failures.
- Phase 1 (viaduct-747e) worker_done re-run: clean.
- Phase 2a (viaduct-659e) worker_done: builder claimed 'flaky, passes in isolation'. Coordinator force-rerun: clean (4 tests, 0 failures in JUnit XML).
- Phase 2b (viaduct-12ad) worker_done: builder ESCALATED — first full-suite run failed with ReadTimeoutException, isolated PASSED, subsequent full-suite PASSED. Coordinator force-rerun: clean.
- Operator approved Option 1 (track + verify per-phase + investigate in Phase 5).

## Causal analysis
Phase 2 changes are PURELY build-time Gradle (AssembleCentralSchemaTask + ViaductApplicationPlugin orchestration). starwars demo never invokes any scope method; NoScopesMode is explicitly preserved. There is no plausible runtime path from Phase 2 to a micronaut HTTP-timing flake.

Hypotheses for follow-up investigation in Phase 5:
1. Embedded micronaut server slow-bind under suite-wide JVM warm-up; BatchResolverIntegrationTest happens to be the first batch-resolver-heavy class to hit the freshly-bound server.
2. Test-class ordering: another class leaves a dataloader / batch-context in an unflushed state that BatchResolverIntegrationTest then collides with under timing pressure.
3. Resource contention with the rest of the suite under --rerun-tasks (cold compile + warm JVM).

## Investigation plan (deferred to Phase 5 regression triage)
- Read demoapps/starwars/src/test/kotlin/com/example/starwars/service/test/BatchResolverIntegrationTest.kt
- Check for shared mutable state across the demoapps/starwars test classes (look for static singletons / object state)
- Check embedded-server lifecycle and HTTP client timeout configuration
- Try reordering test execution to isolate the offender
- Consider raising the HTTP client read timeout if a real timing issue is confirmed (vs masking a real defect — apply test-mindset rule #3)

## Operator decision (msg-8zxrdo6oed8h thread)
Option 1 accepted: track as soft baseline caveat; do not block Phase 2+ merges; investigate at Phase 5.

## DoD
Closed when:
- Root cause identified
- Either fixed permanently OR documented baseline exception with sign-off (analogous to ACS-repo's 5 documented env-fail tests in test-mindset.md §4)
closeReason: Outcome (b): root cause documented (micronaut HTTP client default 10s read-timeout vs cold-start batch-resolver coroutine latency); mitigation applied at demoapps/starwars/src/test/resources/application-test.yml (PT60S); 5 consecutive --rerun-tasks stress runs passed after the mitigation. Full fix (reducing batch resolver cold-start latency in production code) is deferred to a future ticket — out of scope for this feature. Closing per Phase 5 operator-approved outcome (b).

title: Phase 3.1: SchemaConfiguration.fromResources(schemaIds) — META-INF scope-config reader + scope resolver
description:
Task 3.1 from .alucify/implementation-plan.md (v2). Runtime-side counterpart to Phase 2.4 build-time resource-file emission. Foundation for Phase 3 tasks 3.2 + 3.3.

## Scope
Add a new static factory and a scope resolver to viaduct.service.runtime.SchemaConfiguration that consumes the META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json file produced by Phase 2.4's AssembleCentralSchemaTask.

### File: core/service/runtime/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/service/runtime/SchemaConfiguration.kt (MODIFY)
- New static factory: `fun fromResources(schemaIds: Set<String>): SchemaConfiguration` (companion-object method). Distinct overload from the existing `fromResources(grtPackagePrefix, resourcesIncluded, scopes, lazyScopedSchemas)`.
  - Reads /META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json from the current classpath (Thread.currentThread().contextClassLoader OR SchemaConfiguration::class.java.classLoader — match what the existing FromResources path uses)
  - Parses to ResourceFileSchema (viaduct.graphql.schema.scopes.ResourceFileSchema from Phase 1) via ResourceFileSchema.objectMapper()
  - For each requested schemaId in `schemaIds`: look up the scope set in resourceFileSchema.declaredScopedSchemas; if absent → throw ViaductInvalidConfigurationException with the missing id and the set of declared ids
  - Build the internal `scopedSchemas: Map<SchemaId.Scoped, ScopedSchemaConfig.Derived>` the same way the existing factories do, using `ScopeConfig(id, scopeIds).schemaId()`
  - **Eager materialization (lazy=false)** for the fromResources path (per R-24-009; Task 3.3 will verify the eager path; for now the param is hard-coded false)
- New method: `fun resolveSchemaId(id: String): Set<String>` — returns the scope set for an id; returns emptySet() for FULL; throws ViaductInvalidConfigurationException for undeclared ids
- New error classes (or reuse existing if present): viaduct.service.runtime.ViaductInvalidConfigurationException, viaduct.service.runtime.ViaductSchemaLoadException. Check if these already exist before adding; if absent, add as @InternalApi extending appropriate base (likely RuntimeException or an existing Viaduct exception base).
- NoScopesMode handling: if META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json is absent on classpath AND schemaIds == { "FULL" } (or some sentinel), return a NoScopesMode-compatible SchemaConfiguration (only the full schema, no scoped variants). If file is absent AND schemaIds contains anything other than FULL, throw ViaductSchemaLoadException with an actionable message.
- Internal maps must be wrapped in Collections.unmodifiableMap() for thread safety (CC-7). Existing ConcurrentHashMap is fine; expose via unmodifiable view if needed.

### File: core/service/runtime/src/test/kotlin/viaduct/service/runtime/... (NEW + MODIFY)
- New: SchemaConfigurationFromResourcesTest.kt or similar
- Tests:
  - TS-013: fromResources resolves schema IDs correctly from a META-INF fixture
  - TS-014: resolveSchemaId returns correct scope set for declared id; returns emptySet for FULL
  - TS-015: FULL schema ID is always resolvable
  - TS-016: empty scope set resolves to full schema (via the existing applyScopes path)
  - TS-017: resource file read once, cached immutably (assert the resource is loaded at fromResources call, not on every resolveSchemaId)
  - TS-055: SchemaConfiguration immutable after construction; concurrent reads safe (Collections.unmodifiableMap + ConcurrentHashMap)
  - ERROR: fromResources throws ViaductInvalidConfigurationException for undeclared schema id (assert exception type AND message contains offending id)
  - ERROR: fromResources throws ViaductSchemaLoadException for missing META-INF file (when schemaIds contains a non-FULL id)
  - ERROR: fromResources throws ViaductSchemaLoadException for malformed JSON (assert exception type)
  - ROUND-TRIP: build a fixture ResourceFileSchema → serialize via ResourceFileSchema.objectMapper() → place on test classpath → fromResources(declared-ids) recovers the exact same scope sets
  - NoScopesMode: fromResources(setOf("FULL")) succeeds when no META-INF file present; returns config with only the full schema, no scoped variants

### Test fixtures (NEW)
- core/service/runtime/src/test/resources/META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json — a fixture with declaredSchemaScopes=["public","internal","admin"], declaredScopedSchemas={"FULL":[], "api":["public","internal"], "adminApi":["admin"]}, version=1
- Use this fixture in the success tests; use a separate test classpath OR ResourceLoader injection for the absence/malformed cases (test-mindset rule: don't mock the SUT — use a real classpath isolation technique)

## Constraints — NO SPI, NO new runtime validator
Per IMPL plan v2 REGISTRY-9 / Task 3.1 v2 note:
- The runtime filter pipeline is the SAME pipeline used today: SchemaConfiguration.applyScopes (existing) → ScopedSchemaBuilder.applyScopes (existing) → SchemaScopeTransformer.applyScopes (existing) → existing visitors.
- DO NOT introduce a new ValidationRule subclass or ViaductRuleSetProvider lookup at runtime.
- Re-use existing applyScopes path. The build-time validator (Task 2.4) already validated the scope sets; runtime is a defensive backstop only.

title: Phase 3.2 + 3.3: SchemaConfiguration.forTesting factory + eager materialization wiring
description:
Bundle of Task 3.2 (test factory + AbstractFeatureAppTestBase update) and Task 3.3 (eager schema materialization at runtime startup) from .alucify/implementation-plan.md (v2). Depends on Task 3.1 (merged at commit b3ac94d9 — SchemaConfiguration.fromResources(schemaIds) reader).

## Task 3.2 — SchemaConfiguration.forTesting + AbstractFeatureAppTestBase
- File: core/service/runtime/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/service/runtime/SchemaConfiguration.kt (MODIFY)
  - Add `@VisibleForTesting fun forTesting(resourceJson: String): SchemaConfiguration` (companion-object static factory)
  - Accepts the same JSON format as production (parse via ResourceFileSchema.objectMapper())
  - Validates JSON against the same schema as the production reader (i.e., same parse path)
  - Returns a SchemaConfiguration with all declared scoped schemas eagerly registered (lazy=false)
  - Use viaduct.apiannotations.VisibleForTest annotation (the existing @VisibleForTest opt-in marker in this codebase; verify by grep before assuming the name)
- File: core/tenant/runtime/src/testFixtures/kotlin/viaduct/tenant/runtime/fixtures/AbstractFeatureAppTestBase.kt (MODIFY — testFixtures consumer side)
  - Migrate any current scope-set-based instantiation to use SchemaConfiguration.forTesting(resourceJson) via the new factory where appropriate
  - DO NOT change the public test-base contract that downstream feature-app tests depend on; ADDITIVE only. If the existing API is sufficient for tests today, you may leave the test base mostly untouched and just add a NEW helper method (e.g., `protected fun configFromScopeJson(json: String): SchemaConfiguration = SchemaConfiguration.forTesting(json)`)
- File: core/tenant/runtime/src/testFixtures/kotlin/viaduct/api/testing/featureapp/AbstractFeatureAppTestContractBase.kt (POSSIBLY MODIFY — match the pattern in TestBase if any)
- New: core/service/runtime/src/test/kotlin/viaduct/service/runtime/SchemaConfigurationForTestingTest.kt — covers TS-029, TS-030, TS-031, TS-046

## Task 3.3 — Eager schema materialization at runtime startup
- File: core/service/runtime/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/service/runtime/EngineRegistry.kt (MODIFY — current eager-by-default; lazy is opt-in via ScopedSchemaConfig.Derived(lazy=true))
  - Confirm the fromResources(schemaIds) path forces lazy=false (already done in Task 3.1 via Derived(schemaId, lazy=false))
  - Add INFO logging: at SchemaConfiguration construction, log the registered schema IDs
  - Add DEBUG logging: per-scope-set materialization timing (System.nanoTime() before/after the .applyScopes(scopeSet).filtered call) — match existing SLF4J pattern (LoggerFactory.getLogger(EngineRegistry::class.java))
  - Add WARN logging if >20 unique scope sets are registered (R-24-009 + design risk mitigation)
  - Fail fast: if any materialization throws, the EngineRegistry construction throws ViaductInvalidConfigurationException or ViaductSchemaLoadException (whichever is more semantically appropriate per the existing exception hierarchy)
- File: core/service/runtime/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/service/runtime/SchemaScopedModule.kt (POSSIBLY MODIFY — Guice wiring)
  - If new SchemaConfiguration constructor variant needs binding, add it to the existing module
  - DO NOT create a brand new Guice module unless the existing one is unsuitable (per IMPL plan Task 3.3 TASK-3.3-FILE)
  - Verify no circular dependency between api/runtime/wiring layers
- File: core/service/wiring/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/service/BasicViaductFactory.kt (POSSIBLY MODIFY)
- File: core/service/wiring/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/service/ViaductBuilder.kt (POSSIBLY MODIFY)
  - Confirm both factories use SchemaConfiguration.fromResources(schemaIds) where it makes sense, OR add a new factory method that takes Set<String> schemaIds directly
  - Pattern: BasicViaductFactory.create(...) / ViaductBuilder.withSchemaConfiguration(...) — match the existing API style
- Tests:
  - core/service/runtime/src/test/kotlin/viaduct/service/runtime/EngineRegistryEagerMaterializationTest.kt OR augment existing EngineRegistryTest.kt — covers TS-036, TS-037, TS-038, TS-039, TS-040, TS-041
  - core/service/wiring/src/test/kotlin/viaduct/service/ — augment BasicViaductFactoryTest and ViaductBuilderTest if API changes

## Test specifications (TDD — write FAILING tests FIRST)
- TS-029 — forTesting creates usable SchemaConfiguration from JSON; round-trip from real production-format JSON
- TS-030 — method annotated @VisibleForTesting (verify via reflection: assertNotNull(method.getAnnotation(VisibleForTest::class.java)))
- TS-031 — forTesting accepts same JSON format as production reader (compare: same JSON parsed by fromResources(schemaIds, classLoader-with-resource) and forTesting(json) yields same SchemaConfiguration with same scopedSchemas keys/values)
- TS-036 — schema transformation uses existing SchemaScopeTransformer API (assert via spy/mock that ScopedSchemaBuilder.applyScopes is called for each unique scope set)
- TS-037 — uses graphql-java 26.0 API (assert via type checks on returned schemas)
- TS-038 — extends existing SchemaScopeTransformer (assert no new transformer class introduced; check imports)
- TS-039 — getRegisteredSchemaIds returns the correct set (after fromResources(setOf("api","adminApi"))); also returns FULL implicitly
- TS-040 — EngineRegistry immutable after construction; concurrent reads safe (30 threads, latch-coordinated, no ConcurrentModificationException, consistent return values)
- TS-041 — BasicViaductFactory reads SchemaConfiguration during start (assert via timing or via constructor-injection observation that schemas are materialized before first request)
- TS-046 — follows existing @VisibleForTesting factory pattern (search for existing @VisibleForTest uses in the codebase and verify forTesting matches the pattern)
- ERROR: materialization failure aborts startup (intentionally bad SDL via injected fixture should fail-fast with ViaductSchemaLoadException or ViaductInvalidConfigurationException, NOT a silent skip)
- WARN: registering 21+ unique scope sets logs a WARN message (use SLF4J test appender to capture log lines, or a memory logger; do NOT mock the logger itself — use a real list-appender if available, else verify via log-config-driven assertion)
- TIMING: DEBUG log line per scope-set materialization contains materialization_time_ms field

- core/service/wiring:test (primary — ViaductBuilderTest, BasicViaductFactoryTest hot spots)
- core/service/serve:test (regression)

PHASE 3 EXTRA RIGOR: any new failure in EngineRegistryTest / ViaductScopedSchemaIntegrationTest / StandardViaductTest / ViaductOSSEndToEndTest / ScopeFilteringIntrospectionTest / ViaductBuilderTest / BasicViaductFactoryTest is PRESUMED CAUSAL — do NOT dismiss as flaky. Investigate first.

## Constraints

closeReason: Phase 3.2+3.3 merged (commit 2768be62): SchemaConfiguration.forTesting(@VisibleForTest) factory + AbstractFeatureAppTestBase configFromScopeJson helper + EngineRegistry startup INFO logging of registered schemas, WARN at >20 scoped schemas, DEBUG per-scope-set materialization_time_ms, fail-fast wrap in ViaductSchemaLoadException. 16 new tests (6 forTesting + 10 eager-materialization with Logback ListAppender for log assertions). title: Phase 4.1: No-scopes mode verification — NoScopesMode runtime byte-identical to pre-Phase-4 baseline
description:
Task 4.1 from .alucify/implementation-plan.md (v2). Verify that applications without any scope declarations (NoScopesMode) work EXACTLY as before — runtime control flow does not enter scoped-mode branches, no resource file generated/expected, existing FromResources/SchemaFactory paths byte-identical. Pure verification — ZERO production-code changes expected (the test additions are the deliverable).

Depends on Phase 3 (merged at 2768be62). NoScopesMode handling exists in SchemaConfiguration.fromResources(setOf("FULL")) and in EngineRegistry's branch on config.scopedSchemas.isEmpty().

## Scope of work — verification tests only

### File: core/service/runtime/src/test/kotlin/viaduct/service/runtime/NoScopesModeVerificationTest.kt (NEW)
Cover R-20-001 through R-20-009 + R-01-004:
- **R-20-001**: when declaredSchemaScopes is absent, NO META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json is generated. (Verify in starwars demo build output OR in a TestKit fixture that runs AssembleCentralSchemaTask without scope DSL invocation.)
- **R-20-002**: with no resource file, FULL schema ID is the only valid schema ID. Use SchemaConfiguration.fromResources(setOf("FULL")) + a classloader that lacks the META-INF file. Assert config.scopedSchemas.isEmpty(). Assert resolveSchemaId("FULL") returns emptySet(). Assert resolveSchemaId(anything_else) throws ViaductInvalidConfigurationException.
- **R-20-003**: no @scope directive is defined / registered for no-scopes apps. (For runtime side: assert that EngineRegistry built from NoScopesMode SchemaConfiguration does NOT invoke ScopedSchemaBuilder.applyScopes. Use MockK spy on the build path.)
- **R-20-004**: SchemaConfiguration.fromResources(setOf("FULL")) returns a config in NoScopesMode (scopedSchemas empty, fullSchemaConfig present).
- **R-20-005**: no scope validation runs during build (for the build side, verify via the Phase 2.4 AssembleCentralSchemaTask test path that runScopePipeline is NOT invoked when extension.getSchemaScopeInfo() == NoScopesMode — augment AssembleCentralSchemaTaskScopePipelineTest if needed).
- **R-20-006**: no scope-related INFO/DEBUG/WARN log output at runtime in NoScopesMode. Use Logback ListAppender (pattern from Phase 3.3 EngineRegistryEagerMaterializationTest). Assert NO log entry contains "scope", "scoped", or "materialization_time_ms" when EngineRegistry is built with NoScopesMode SchemaConfiguration.
- **R-20-007**: existing FromResources path unchanged. Assert SchemaConfiguration.fromResources() (no-arg, the existing path) produces a config with no scoped schemas and a FromResources fullSchemaConfig.
- **R-20-008**: SchemaFactory behavior identical to pre-feature state. Build a SchemaConfiguration via the no-arg fromResources, build EngineRegistry, get the full schema, assert it equals (structurally) a schema built directly via the SchemaFactory.
- **R-20-009**: ALL existing starwars demo tests pass without modification. This is implicit in the downstream gate; assert it explicitly in the result mail.
- **R-01-004**: backward compatibility — pre-Phase-4 baseline behavior preserved. This task adds the baseline assertions; no behavior change.

### File: core/service/runtime/src/test/kotlin/viaduct/service/runtime/NoScopesModeControlFlowTest.kt (NEW or merged into the above)
Critical CONTROL-FLOW check (operator's reinforcement #5): assert that the runtime control flow does NOT enter scoped-mode branches when NoScopesMode is in effect.
- Use MockK spies on ScopedSchemaBuilder.applyScopes / SchemaConfiguration.applyScopes / ScopedSchemaConfig.Derived.build to count invocations.
- Build EngineRegistry from a NoScopesMode SchemaConfiguration; execute a sample query; assert ZERO invocations of any scoped-mode method.
- Build EngineRegistry from a ScopedMode SchemaConfiguration; same query; assert >0 invocations on the matching scoped path. (Positive control to confirm the spy actually catches invocations.)

### Optional but recommended: gradle-plugins/application — verify NoScopesMode in build
Add or augment AssembleCentralSchemaTaskScopePipelineTest:
- Test that when ViaductApplicationExtension.getSchemaScopeInfo() == NoScopesMode, AssembleCentralSchemaTask does NOT write META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json to outputDirectory.
- This verifies the build-time path of R-20-001.

title: Phase 4.2: SchemaConfiguration / SchemaId consumer migration with @Deprecated transition
description:
Task 4.2 from .alucify/implementation-plan.md (v2). Migrate all 21 in-tree consumers of raw scope-set-based SchemaConfiguration APIs and SchemaId.Scoped DIRECT CONSTRUCTION to the new SchemaConfiguration.fromResources(schemaIds) / forTesting / resolveSchemaId paths from Phase 3. @Deprecated(level=WARNING) on the old API throughout; NO REMOVAL — that is Task 4.3.

## Critical disciplines
- BISECT-FRIENDLY: each commit on the worktree branch must leave the merge target buildable + all gates green. NO "this commit only compiles after the next" sequences.
- @Deprecated(message="Use ... instead", replaceWith=ReplaceWith("..."), level=DeprecationLevel.WARNING) on the surface being migrated. NOT level=ERROR. Stay functional.
- Consumer migration in dependency order: service/api → service/runtime → service/wiring → tenant/runtime testFixtures → tenant/runtime tests → x/javaapi → demoapps/spring-starter.
- Causal-path bar is HIGHEST: any new test failure is presumed-causal; investigate WITH stack trace before deferring.
- BatchResolverIntegrationTest flake (viaduct-8705): in Phase 4 the bar for "no causal path" is even higher — causal analysis required if it recurs.

## Migration shape
NOTE: SchemaId.Scoped is REFERENCED in many places but DIRECTLY CONSTRUCTED in fewer. The migration target is direct construction sites (e.g. `SchemaId.Scoped("api", setOf("public"))`) — those should be replaced with usage of:
- SchemaConfiguration.fromResources(setOf("api", ...)) — for runtime-app code
- SchemaConfiguration.forTesting(json) — for test fixtures
- SchemaConfiguration.resolveSchemaId("api") — when the scope set is needed at the boundary

References to SchemaId.Scoped AS A TYPE (e.g. `fun foo(id: SchemaId.Scoped)`) stay until Task 4.3 final removal. The transition is: stop CONSTRUCTING; resolution moves into the SchemaConfiguration layer.

For each file, audit and rewrite:
1. If file CONSTRUCTS SchemaId.Scoped("foo", setOf("bar")) directly → migrate to a config-based factory call. Add @Deprecated(level=WARNING) on the constructor or factory if it's a public surface AND no consumers remain that rely on it.
2. If file CONSUMES a SchemaId.Scoped parameter type → leave the parameter; rewrite call sites to use the new factory APIs.
3. If file is a test fixture: prefer SchemaConfiguration.forTesting(json) with explicit fixture JSON (Phase 3.2's @VisibleForTest factory).

## What MUST NOT change in 4.2
- SchemaId.Scoped class declaration itself (kept until Task 4.3)
- SchemaConfiguration's existing public surface — only @Deprecated annotations added; behavior unchanged
- core/shared/graphql sources (Phases 1–2 are frozen)
- ResourceFileSchema or ScopeMode (Phase 1 frozen)
- AssembleCentralSchemaTask / ScopeMaterializationPipeline (Phase 2.4 frozen)

## Tests
- Add no NEW behavior tests in 4.2; the migration MUST keep existing tests green.
- Migration WILL change test setup code — those tests change FUNCTIONALLY but their assertions stay identical. Verify each migrated test still exercises the same paths.
- If a test newly fails after migration: presumed causal. Investigate with stack trace; DO NOT defer to viaduct-8705 unless the test's class name appears in that issue (only BatchResolverIntegrationTest does).

title: Phase 4.3: Remove SchemaId.Scoped — final consumer cleanup + class deletion
description:
Task 4.3 from .alucify/implementation-plan.md (v2). FINAL step of Phase 4: remove the SchemaId.Scoped variant entirely from core/service/api/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/service/api/SchemaId.kt. All remaining SchemaId.Scoped references (the 'intentionally untouched' from Task 4.2 + any new ones) must be eliminated.

Per IMPL plan Task 4.3 + R-00-008 + R-25-001..003: SchemaId.Scoped is @InternalApi, NOT @StableApi — removal is NOT a semver-breaking change for public consumers.

## Current SchemaId shape (core/service/api/.../SchemaId.kt)
```
@StableApi
abstract class SchemaId(open val id: String) {
    @InternalApi data class Scoped(override val id: String, val scopeIds: Set<String>) : SchemaId(id)
    @StableApi object Full : SchemaId("FULL")
    @StableApi object None : SchemaId("NONE")
}
```

## Target shape (suggested; final form is builder's call as long as IMPL goals met)
- SchemaId.Scoped REMOVED
- SchemaId stays as a string-based identifier; Full and None stay as named singletons
- ANY ID that previously needed SchemaId.Scoped(id, scopeIds) becomes either SchemaId(id) (if the type allows construction) OR Full/None — scope sets are resolved via SchemaConfiguration.resolveSchemaId(id), not embedded in the SchemaId object

Simplest target:
```
@StableApi
open class SchemaId(open val id: String) {
    @StableApi object Full : SchemaId("FULL")
    @StableApi object None : SchemaId("NONE")
    override fun toString(): String = "SchemaId(id='$id')"
}
```
Or alternative — keep abstract + factory method:
```
abstract class SchemaId(open val id: String) {
    companion object {
        @InternalApi
        fun of(id: String): SchemaId = ofImpl(id)
    }
    // ...
}
```
Builder's call. Whichever shape, all the existing consumer sites need to compile.

## Surfaces to clean up (resolved from "intentionally untouched" in Task 4.2 worker_done)

1. **core/service/api/.../SchemaId.kt** — REMOVE Scoped class; reshape SchemaId as above
2. **core/service/runtime/.../SchemaConfiguration.kt:414** — the private ScopeConfig.schemaId() extension that constructs SchemaId.Scoped — update to use the new shape OR inline
3. **core/service/wiring/.../ViaductBuilder.kt:230** — inside deprecated SchemaScopeInfo secondary ctor — update construction to new shape
4. **EngineRegistryTest.kt:139,245** — sentinel SchemaId.Scoped("nonexistent") for SchemaNotFoundException tests — replace with new SchemaId shape
5. **EngineRegistryTest.kt:417,434,462,487,511,534** — deprecated registerSchema() tests — update construction; registerSchema(schemaId, ...) signature may need to change from SchemaId.Scoped → SchemaId; the registerSchema method is @Deprecated and Airbnb-only, so signature change is OK
6. **EngineRegistryEagerMaterializationTest.kt:193,269** — same deprecated registerSchema path

ALSO check tree-wide for any OTHER post-4.2 lingering SchemaId.Scoped references and update them all. Run `grep -rn "SchemaId.Scoped" --include="*.kt" --include="*.java" --include="*.kts" core gradle-plugins demoapps publications x build-logic` BEFORE final commit; the result MUST contain ONLY:
  - The (now-removed) line in the original SchemaId.kt diff
  - Any comment/docstring history references (OK)
  - Zero live code references

## Sealed-class exhaustive matching check
SchemaId is `abstract class` (not sealed) per current source — so removal won't trigger Kotlin sealed-when-exhaustiveness compile errors. HOWEVER, `when (id) { is SchemaId.Scoped -> ...; is SchemaId.Full -> ...; is SchemaId.None -> ... }` blocks that explicitly match SchemaId.Scoped WILL fail to compile after removal. Grep for `is SchemaId.Scoped` and `is Scoped` in the SchemaId context tree-wide; update each match-site to either:
  - Remove the case (if the surrounding code is dead)
  - Replace with a string-id check on `id`
  - Replace with `is Full` / `is None` if those are the only remaining cases

## Tests
- Add no new BEHAVIOR tests (this is a removal). All existing tests must stay green.
- Add ONE removal-verification test in core/service/api or sibling: assert via reflection that SchemaId.Scoped class no longer exists. `Class.forName("viaduct.service.api.SchemaId\$Scoped")` should throw ClassNotFoundException.
- The Phase 4.1 NoScopesMode tests stay frozen and green.

## Downstream test gates (run ALL — every commit)
- core/service/api:test (primary — your removal lives here)
- core/service/runtime:test
- core/service/wiring:test
- core/service/serve:test
- core/engine/api:test
- core/engine/runtime:test
- core/tenant/api:test, :testFixtures
- core/tenant/runtime:test, :testFixtures
- core/tenant/tutorials:test
- core/x/javaapi/api:test, :testFixtures
- core/x/javaapi/runtime:test
- demoapps/starwars:test (no-scopes regression — MUST stay byte-identical green)
- demoapps/spring-starter — `./gradlew build`; if `:test` exists run it. SchemaId.Scoped reference must compile after migration.

## Constraints
- Branch: spawned worktree
- Local commits only — NEVER push
- ONE logical commit per concern (cleanup-residuals | remove-Scoped | verify) — bisect-friendly
